title: Lickitung Cleans Dirt, Then Makes It Stink
premise: Lickitung can lick filth clean, but whatever it licks always stinks afterward.
audiencePromise: Show why Lickitung's cleaning trick creates a strange clean-versus-stinky contradiction.
openLoop: If Lickitung removes the filth, why does the result still stink?
payoff: Lickitung may remove the grime, but its own Pokédex leaves the word clean debatable.
engagementQuestion: Would you call that clean, or just less dirty?

voice.instructions: Warm, quick, and playful. Stress clean, stink, and questionable. Pause briefly before the final choice.
